name: review-feedback-projection
body: The Reviews rel-table declaration and write-through admission path. The fix edits exactly two functions. `apg.load.spec_rel_pairs` (src/load.rs:867–943) enumerates the `(table, from, to)` pairs — add `Note` to the `Reviews` target loop only, keeping it excluded from the shared `Details` loop. `apg.load.create_schema` (src/load.rs:1091–1175) emits the matching `CREATE REL TABLE` statements — add the `FROM Feedback TO Note` arm. The downstream read/derivation path is reused unchanged and is not edited: `apg.load.rel_table_pairs` (src/load.rs:993–1014) derives its union from `spec_rel_pairs`, `apg.artifacts.rel_pair_allowed` (src/artifacts.rs:822–832) consults that union, and `apg.artifacts.ArtifactDb.merge_edge` (src/artifacts.rs:497–555) MERGEs the edge or skips it. No change to those three is required — once the pair is declared end to end, `merge_edge` admits the legal review edge rather than silently dropping it.
